svg.title: TaiChu 太初 full language-model training lifecycle
svg.desc: The TaiChu circular mountain-and-cloud logo beside a seven-stage lifecycle: data, tokenizer, pretraining, SFT, DPO or RLHF, agent training, and evaluation. Current, planned, and continuous stages are visually separated.

g.text: 从 Tokenizer 到预训练与对齐训练，
逐步扩展到 Agent 与持续评估。
已经实现的部分保持可审计；规划中的阶段明确标记为 PLAN。
